step1.title: Overview Summary
step1.content: Here you can see your total debt and monthly payments at a glance. This helps you understand your overall financial situation.

step2.title: AI Assistant
step2.content: Use the AI Assistant to control the app with voice or text commands! You can create or edit debts, add payment commitments, complete commitments, delete debts, record calls, show overview, toggle hide amounts, and navigate to different pages. Just type or speak your command naturally.

step3.title: Add Your First Debt
step3.content: Click this button to add a new debt. You'll enter details like the bank name, debt type, amounts, and monthly fees.

step4.title: Your Debts
step4.content: Each card shows a debt with its details. You can expand it to see payment commitments, call history, and manage the debt. Drag and drop cards to reorder them by priority.

step5.title: Payment Commitments
step5.content: Create payment commitments to track agreements with your bank. You can set partial payments, full payments, or settlements. When you complete a commitment, your debt totals update automatically.

step6.title: Record Calls
step6.content: Track your communication with banks by recording calls. You can also create payment commitments directly from a call record.

step7.title: Complete Payments
step7.content: When you complete a payment commitment, the app automatically updates your debt totals based on the payment type (partial, full, or settlement). This keeps everything in sync.

step8.title: Quick Actions
step8.content: Use these buttons to hide/show amounts, learn about the debt snowball method, or access your profile and preferences.

about.title: Oinkly
about.subtitle: Your path to financial freedom
about.methodDescription: Pay off your smallest debt first. Build momentum. Win faster. Your debts auto-organize from smallest to largest—focus on one while paying minimums on others.
about.step1Description: Capture what you know about each debt. Don't stress about perfection—clarity beats accuracy.
about.step2Description: See which debt to tackle first. The app sorts automatically—your path forward is clear.
about.step3Description: Stay in touch. Record every call. Track every commitment. Never miss a detail.
about.step4Description: Complete commitments. Update balances. Watch your plan evolve with each payment.
about.step5Description: See your progress. Your plan adapts automatically. The path to debt-free is always clear.
about.tip1Description: Update balances after payments. Accurate info = better decisions.
about.tip2Description: Every bank agreement goes in the app. Stay organized. Never miss a payment.
about.tip3Description: Every conversation matters. Date, discussion, agreements. Build your communication history.
about.tip4Description: See how far you've come. Visual progress keeps you motivated and committed.
about.philosophy1Description: Debt management shouldn't be complicated. We focus on what matters: organize, track, communicate.
about.philosophy2Description: Be proactive. Stay informed. Track every agreement. Oinkly helps you stay in control.
about.philosophy3Description: See where you are. See where you're going. Progress becomes tangible. Motivation stays strong.
